description: Use when an agent needs to know how it is seen from outside: its public IP plus the country, region, city, ASN, AS organization. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /util/ip, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.
name: util_ip
